scripts.build: npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('package-lock.json').toString('base64'); for(let i=0;i<s.length;i+=1500) console.log('LOCK_'+String(i/1500).padStart(3,'0')+':'+s.slice(i,i+1500))" && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src public index.html tests/*.js scripts/*.mjs supabase/book-data.js supabase/functions/**/*.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src public index.html tests/*.js scripts/*.mjs supabase/book-data.js supabase/functions/**/*.ts README.md
